usage: Demonic masters are retained for future art edits. Only 64x80 demonic-pixels PNGs are used by the portrait reveal. Originals remain the resting portraits.

prompts.av: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: supplied vintage studio portrait. Create a DRASTIC haunted demonic alternate portrait for a coarse pixelated hover reveal. The previous subtle version was too subtle: changes must read clearly even downsampled to 32 by 40 pixels. A huge impossibly wide toothy rictus grin, clearly separated oversized pale teeth, a stretched mouth, deeply furrowed predatory brow. Make BOTH EYES unnaturally entirely BLACK with tiny ghost-white pupils and LARGE black sunken sockets, strong dark tear-like shadow tracks below eyes, gaunt sculpted cheeks and harsh haunted facial contrast. Unsettling supernatural possession, extreme facial EXPRESSION, realistic movie prosthetic photography, not cartoon. Preserve the same person's recognizable identity, head center, eye positions, head angle, overall face silhouette, hair, glasses if present, moustache if present, shoulders, EXACT pose, suit, tie, background and 4:5 crop. Keep the vintage grain and warm monochrome gray palette. Change facial expression and haunted facial details aggressively but do not move or enlarge the head. No gore, no blood, no wounds, no horns, no flames, no colored eyes, no text. Output one full portrait with NO pixelation baked in.
